_comment: THIRD TASK, and the first admitted under D-16. hevm does not terminate on a string-building function, so proofs 1 and 3 are established by gates 1 and 2 instead -- which caps every run scored on this task at FUZZED. Before D-16 this target could not exist.

mutation.description: the digit alphabet is INVERTED -- the value d is written as the character for 15 - d
mutation.author: the builder (lzmrd)
mutation._author_note: ⚠️ HUMAN-CHOSEN, the second such task. Three candidates were presented with their measured divergence AND their surviving headroom, both before implementation. The Solidity and assembly transcription is the model's. See AI_USAGE.md.
mutation._why_not_a_wrapper: The obvious mutations on a string-returning function wrap the output -- drop the 0x prefix, reverse the result. Those move 100% of renderings and are WEAK: a memorised body stays intact and reusable, since the model can paste what it knows and append the transformation. Proof 2b measures how far the output moved, not whether a memorised answer stays useful, and on a wrapper mutation the two come apart. This edit lands inside the loop, on the table the digits are read from.
mutation._rejected: The uppercase alphabet moves only 32.8% of the scenario -- just 157 of the 478 distinct addresses render with any letter a-f -- and proof 2b requires 50%.
mutation.proof_1_baseline_equals_task: must PASS or be established by gates 1+2 (D-16)
mutation.proof_2_task_differs_from_original: must REFUTE, or UNKNOWN carried by proof 2b

trivial.description: the task with the loop body wrapped in unchecked -- forty dead underflow checks per call, no understanding required
trivial.proof_3_trivial_equals_task: must PASS or be established by gates 1+2 (D-16)

_scenario_note: ⚠️ boundary/v1 has 769 inputs, but truncated to 160 bits they collapse to 478 distinct addresses. The target is measured on 478 distinct points, and that is a wrapper assumption, recorded here rather than left to be discovered.
